        [3 if left[r][c] != left_bg and right[r][c] != right_bg else right_bg

from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)

    # Locate the uniform divider column.
    sep = next(
        c for c in range(w)
        if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))
        and counts[grid[0][c]] == h
    )

    left = [row[:sep] for row in grid]
    right = [row[sep + 1:] for row in grid]

    shared = set(v for row in left for v in row) & set(v for row in right for v in row)
    background = next(iter(shared))

    return [
        [3 if left[r][c] == right[r][c] else background
         for c in range(len(left[0]))]
        for r in range(h)
    ]
